'''Avraam I. Isayev''' (born 1942) is a [[University of Akron]] professor of [[polymer engineering]]<ref>{{cite web |title=AWARDS » James L. White Award » Avraam Isayev |url=https://psfebus.allenpress.com/eBusPOPR/AWARDS/JamesLWhiteAward/avraamisayev.aspx |website=allenpress.com |publisher=Polymer Processing Society |access-date=10 August 2022}}</ref> known for widely used texts on rheology<ref>{{cite book |last1=Malkin |first1=Alexander Y. |last2=Isayev |first2=Avraam I. |title=Rheology Concepts, Methods, and Applications |date=March 21, 2022 |publisher=Elsevier Science |isbn=9781927885949 |url=https://books.google.com/books?id=JNhOEAAAQBAJ |access-date=26 September 2022}}</ref> and polymer molding technology,<ref>{{cite book |last1=Isayev |first1=Avraam I. |title=Injection and Compression Molding Fundamentals (Plastics Engineering) |date=June 29, 1987 |publisher=CRC Press |isbn=978-0824776701 |edition=1 }}</ref> as well as for the development of technology for [[ultrasonic]] [[Sulfur vulcanization#Devulcanization|devulcanization]] of tire rubber.<ref>{{cite journal |last1=Isayev |first1=A. I. |last2=Chen |first2=J. |last3=Tukachinsky |first3=A. |title=Novel ultrasonic technology for devulcanization of waste rubbers |journal=Rubber Chemistry and Technology |date=1995 |volume=68 |issue=2 |pages=267-280 |doi=10.5254/1.3538741}}</ref>

== Education ==
Isayev was born in [[Azerbaijan SSR|Azerbaijan]] and is a US citizen. He earned two master's degrees, the first in Chemical Engineering from [[Azerbaijan State Oil and Industry University|Azerbaijan Institute of Oil and Chemistry]] in Baku (USSR) in 1964, and a second in applied mathematics from the Institute of Electronic Machine Building in Moscow (USSR) in 1975. He completed a doctorate in Polymer Engineering and Science at the Institute of Petrochemical Synthesis of the Academy of Sciences of the USSR in Moscow in 1970.<ref>{{cite journal |last1=Wilczynski |first1=Krzysztof |title=Profesor Avraam I. Isayev |journal=Polimery |date=June 2013 |volume=58 |issue=6 |page=482 |url=https://go.gale.com/ps/i.do?id=GALE%7CA334486485&sid=googleScholar&v=2.1&it=r&linkaccess=abs&issn=00322725&p=AONE&sw=w&userGroupName=anon%7Ec09cff3b |access-date=26 September 2022}}</ref>

== Career ==
{{BLP unsourced section|date=October 2022}}
Isayev began his career in 1970 at the Institute of Petrochemical Synthesis of the Academy of Sciences in Moscow. In 1977, he joined the [[Israel Institute of Technology]] in Israel. He joined Cornell University in 1979. He joined the Polymer Engineering department at the University of Akron in 1983.  He has been a visiting professor at [[Kyoto University]], [[University of Aachen]], and the [[University of Linz]]. During the period from 1990 to 2009, he was the director of the Molding Technology Research and Development Center (MOLDTECH). He is the editor-in-chief of the journal Advances in Polymer Technology.
